units.source_text: 像是打了个盹儿，只是一会儿。

en.t: It was as if he had dozed off, just for a little while.

units.source_text: 转眼之间，汗水出来了，别说衬衫了，就连长裤膝盖的内侧也弄得湿漉漉的。

en.t: In the blink of an eye, sweat came pouring out; not only his shirt, but even the insides of the knees of his trousers were soaked.

units.source_text: 汗水上黏附着沙子，颜色也好，手感也好，都和麦粉做的松糕十分相像。

en.t: Sand clung to the sweat, and both in color and in feel it closely resembled steamed cake made from wheat flour.

units.source_text: 她脸上，忘记了盖东西，鼻子、嘴巴都像冬天的水田，干巴巴的。

en.t: On her face, where she had forgotten to cover anything, her nose and mouth were as dry and cracked as winter rice fields.
